claude.request:
Today's international headlines:
- Iran war won't end until after crucial November elections, says Trump: The president also said oil prices won't come down until after the November races, claiming without evidence that Iran wants to impact the election.
- Trump pledges $5,000 to every American - and other takeaways from  Republican midterms convention: He covered many of the subjects he has returned to time and again - with a few surprises thrown in.
- Five dead and 86 missing as 'heartbreaking' fire breaks out on Philippines ferry: The fire broke out as the vessel nearing its destination at the tourist hotspot of Coron in Palawan.
- Spanish intelligence warned of Ceuta mass crossing plans before surge: Declassified documents show Spanish and Moroccan authorities were alerted to social media calls for a mass migrant crossing the day before tens of thousands entered Ceuta.
- Google picks Finland for its largest single investment in Europe: The US tech giant says the €13bn data centre project will create tens of thousands of jobs.
- Germany's Merz attacks AfD in stormy debate after far-right election win: Germany's chancellor clashes with AfD leader Alice Weidel, saying her migration policy amounts to "ethnic cleansing" for skilled workers.
- Uganda pulling out of Prince Harry's Invictus Games, says military chief: The decision, announced by the chief of defence, comes just two months after Uganda said it would participate.
- Europe's royalty pay respects to King Harald V in Norway: The Prince of Wales and three Nordic kings were among those who attended proceedings on Wednesday.
- Trump gave $45,000 cash gifts to Natalie Harp and two other aides, public records show: The White House has described the cash gifts to Harp and three others as personal - and legal.
- N Korea has built two-storey uranium enrichment facility, says watchdog: The International Atomic Energy Agency's says the facility is cause for "serious concern".
- Two die at Moldovan border as Russia-Ukraine drone war rages: Five deaths are reported in Ukraine and four in Russia as both sides launch new drone strikes.
- Family of killed teen call for death penalty in D4vd trial: The parents of Celeste Rivas Hernandez say execution "would be perfect" if D4vd is found guilty.
